name: Wakayama

flag.description: A navy emblem on a white field: the katakana ワ (wa) drawn as an open folding fan.
flag.symbolism: ワ is the first sound of Wakayama, and the widening fan stands for endless growth.

hook: Wakayama's navy ワ (wa) on white opens like a fan; Nagasaki's blue N on white is a dove.
trivia: The Kumano Kodō pilgrimage routes and Mount Kōya are UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
Wakayama grows more mandarin oranges than any other prefecture.
